name: copy-problem-context-agent
description: Copy compact VS Code diagnostic context for agent prompts and terminal workflows.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Copying problem context is supported in Restricted Mode. Sending copied problem text to a terminal requires Workspace Trust.

commands.title: Copy Problem Context Agent: Copy for Agent
Copy Problem Context Agent: Copy and Run in Terminal

copyProblemMessage.contextLines.markdownDescription: Number of lines before and after the selected diagnostic to include, and the maximum line distance from the cursor when finding a problem.

copyProblemMessage.runSuffixMessage.default: Understand the root cause and implement fix.
copyProblemMessage.runSuffixMessage.markdownDescription: Message appended to the copied problem context before sending it to the terminal. Set to an empty string to disable the suffix.
